DIAGNOSIS READY: Eisenmenger Syndrome (severe pulmonary hypertension with right-to-left shunting).

The echocardiogram reveals an atrial septal defect, but your normal BNP and lack of pulmonary edema despite significant heart enlargement suggest a complex shunt physiology where blood is bypassing the lungs, likely causing hypoxia and secondary polycythemia. I need to confirm if you are experiencing cyanosis (blue discoloration of lips or skin) or shortness of breath that worsens with exertion.
